text: In that war, there was an instant when the ships of Gaul ripped apart the lines of death like a sharp sword, before death swallowed them.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Why do I see a shadow of him in your Arts?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Why do I see a shadow of him in your Arts?

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Your words can't kill me.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]The voice that calls me is louder than your incantations by far.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: The voice that calls me is louder than your incantations by far.

speaker: Logos
content: ...I can hear it.

raw: [name="Logos"]The dirge of the fallen echoes within you.
speaker: Logos
content: The dirge of the fallen echoes within you.

[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: Thousands of war altars, spread across the battlefield.

raw: They absorb what life leaves behind when it dies.
content: They absorb what life leaves behind when it dies.

raw: The culmination of the power stands before Logos.
content: The culmination of the power stands before Logos.

raw: The most powerful Nachzehrer, and the most terrible war altar.
content: The most powerful Nachzehrer, and the most terrible war altar.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Nachzehrers witness death.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]We take in all who were brave, friend or foe. In the endless cycle of life and death, they will be remembered and honored.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: We take in all who were brave, friend or foe. In the endless cycle of life and death, they will be remembered and honored.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Cowards deserve only dust.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Tell me, my foe—is it a young hero who stands before me, or a despicable traitor?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Tell me, my foe—is it a young hero who stands before me, or a despicable traitor?

speaker: Logos
content: Your judgment does not interest me.

raw: [name="Logos"]This is not where the power of words lie.
speaker: Logos
content: This is not where the power of words lie.

raw: Logos once again gathers power in his palm.
content: Logos once again gathers power in his palm.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
A second wound appears on Nezzsalem's body, stretching from the shoulder to his chest.
content: A second wound appears on Nezzsalem's body, stretching from the shoulder to his chest.

raw: The incantation does not dissipate. It fends off the branches trying to close in, and prevents the energies of the dead from repairing the Nachzehrer's body.
content: The incantation does not dissipate. It fends off the branches trying to close in, and prevents the energies of the dead from repairing the Nachzehrer's body.

raw: Shredded cloth rises and falls, covering the new wound, and countless old scars.
content: Shredded cloth rises and falls, covering the new wound, and countless old scars.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: What is this?

raw: [name="Logos"]Death may feed the Nachzehrer, but the Banshee can put death itself to rest.
speaker: Logos
content: Death may feed the Nachzehrer, but the Banshee can put death itself to rest.

raw: [name="Logos"]You are no longer the sole master of war, Nezzsalem.
speaker: Logos
content: You are no longer the sole master of war, Nezzsalem.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]You're more gifted in incantation than any Banshee I know, Laqeramaline included.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You're more gifted in incantation than any Banshee I know, Laqeramaline included.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: A shame, though.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Why do you not sing for the dead, if you truly mourn them?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Why do you not sing for the dead, if you truly mourn them?

raw: [name="Logos"]Elegy cannot actually put the dead to rest.
speaker: Logos
content: Elegy cannot actually put the dead to rest.

raw: [name="Logos"]Neither the living nor the dead will find true rest, as long as war continues.
speaker: Logos
content: Neither the living nor the dead will find true rest, as long as war continues.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Preposterous!

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]You have vanquished the Damazti and banished the Vampire. You, a sovereign of the Royal Court, have Royal Court blood on your hands.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You have vanquished the Damazti and banished the Vampire. You, a sovereign of the Royal Court, have Royal Court blood on your hands.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]You dare say it is all because you are avoiding war?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You dare say it is all because you are avoiding war?

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Is your rebellion the only reason you stand in my way?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Is your rebellion the only reason you stand in my way?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
The Nachzehrer floats up in fury. The branches underneath him disintegrate, and decay fills the canyon.
content: The Nachzehrer floats up in fury. The branches underneath him disintegrate, and decay fills the canyon.

raw: The Banshee's chanting does not give ground.
content: The Banshee's chanting does not give ground.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Born in death, fueled by war, and nourishing death.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Born in death, fueled by war, and nourishing death.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The life of the Nachzehrer is as war itself.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The life of the Nachzehrer is as war itself.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Cities and kingdoms rise and fall, but the fate of the Nachzehrer never changes.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Cities and kingdoms rise and fall, but the fate of the Nachzehrer never changes.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Once, a Nachzehrer clan, tired of the cycle, put down their swords and staves and went into the depths of the wastes, far from civilization.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Once, a Nachzehrer clan, tired of the cycle, put down their swords and staves and went into the depths of the wastes, far from civilization.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Their powers declined rapidly in peace, and they soon became prey for others, fading away in a forgotten corner of the land.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Their powers declined rapidly in peace, and they soon became prey for others, fading away in a forgotten corner of the land.

raw: [Subtitle(text="There is no other way to ensure the continued existence of the Nachzehrers.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: There is no other way to ensure the continued existence of the Nachzehrers.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The great rock of war sits above our heads on the slopes of time. All we can do is to push it with all our strength.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The great rock of war sits above our heads on the slopes of time. All we can do is to push it with all our strength.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Such cycle has continued for thousands of years.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Such cycle has continued for thousands of years.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Until—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Until—

text: We promise a war, Nachzehrer King—

raw: [Subtitle(text="About the future, and nothing else.", x=300, y=620, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: About the future, and nothing else.

raw: [Subtitle(text="My best students, the young twin royals. I taught them the laws of war. They stood before me and told me—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: My best students, the young twin royals. I taught them the laws of war. They stood before me and told me—

raw: [Subtitle(text="We can end the monotony of war and break the rigid cycle.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: We can end the monotony of war and break the rigid cycle.

raw: [Subtitle(text="We can push the rock to the top of the mountain and build a splendid palace with it.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: We can push the rock to the top of the mountain and build a splendid palace with it.

raw: [Subtitle(text="This war will be my blaze of glory.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This war will be my blaze of glory.

raw: [Subtitle(text="It must not end here!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: It must not end here!

raw: [Subtitle(text="That was a long time ago.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: That was a long time ago.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Now, a young Banshee stands before me.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Now, a young Banshee stands before me.

raw: [Subtitle(text="How could they be so alike?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: How could they be so alike?

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]I fought alongside Laqeramaline for decades, across cities and plains. We buried the armor of Victoria and the guns of Gaul beneath the walls of Kazdel together.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I fought alongside Laqeramaline for decades, across cities and plains. We buried the armor of Victoria and the guns of Gaul beneath the walls of Kazdel together.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]In the same battle, I helped Theresa take the heads of thousands of Leithanian casters.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: In the same battle, I helped Theresa take the heads of thousands of Leithanian casters.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]They were the heroes of Kazdel, its greatest warriors.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: They were the heroes of Kazdel, its greatest warriors.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Laqeramaline entrusted you with the future of the Banshees. Theresa considered you one of her best students.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Laqeramaline entrusted you with the future of the Banshees. Theresa considered you one of her best students.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]But you hid at Rhodes Island, sheltered the King of Sarkaz, and sneaked into Londinium like a thief, content to sabotage the cracks in the battlefield...
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: But you hid at Rhodes Island, sheltered the King of Sarkaz, and sneaked into Londinium like a thief, content to sabotage the cracks in the battlefield...

raw: [name="Logos"]War will not end the suffering of the Sarkaz.
speaker: Logos
content: War will not end the suffering of the Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Logos"]All I see is you dragging everyone into the abyss.
speaker: Logos
content: All I see is you dragging everyone into the abyss.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: So you chose to run.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Many years ago, I said to Theresa that war was unavoidable. If it did not come to Londinium, it would come to Kazdel.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Many years ago, I said to Theresa that war was unavoidable. If it did not come to Londinium, it would come to Kazdel.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Theresa agreed, but continued to hope that there could be another solution.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Theresa agreed, but continued to hope that there could be another solution.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Her choice led to a new war. Its consequence was the death of the King of Sarkaz.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Her choice led to a new war. Its consequence was the death of the King of Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]I witnessed her death. All Sarkaz should honor her.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I witnessed her death. All Sarkaz should honor her.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: What about you?

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]What can you bring the Sarkaz aside from these meek words? What do you want to bring the Sarkaz?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: What can you bring the Sarkaz aside from these meek words? What do you want to bring the Sarkaz?

raw: He points his staff at the ground.
content: He points his staff at the ground.

raw: The scent of decay rushes out, overpowering the barrier of incantations.
content: The scent of decay rushes out, overpowering the barrier of incantations.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Sudaram
content: (Growls)

raw: [CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
The dirge of the myriad souls grows louder.
content: The dirge of the myriad souls grows louder.

raw: The power of the incantations is weakening. He feels his fingers, lips and tongue go numb.
content: The power of the incantations is weakening. He feels his fingers, lips and tongue go numb.

raw: The fury does not come only from the ancient Royal Court sovereign before him.
content: The fury does not come only from the ancient Royal Court sovereign before him.

raw: It is also coming from his own blood.
content: It is also coming from his own blood.
I told you.

raw: [name="Logos"]Duq'arael. I witnessed with my own eyes...
speaker: Logos
content: Duq'arael. I witnessed with my own eyes...

speaker: Duq'arael
content: ...My death?

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You and the King both know you can't kill me.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You and the King both know you can't kill me.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]With your help, I've come to an... interesting place. It is not all nothingness beyond history.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: With your help, I've come to an... interesting place. It is not all nothingness beyond history.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]But I continue to gaze at you beyond the veil.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: But I continue to gaze at you beyond the veil.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You have come so far, little Banshee... you and the Outblood King seek the drop of blood that I left behind.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You have come so far, little Banshee... you and the Outblood King seek the drop of blood that I left behind.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]The Blood of Teekaz... the pure blood that I coveted.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: The Blood of Teekaz... the pure blood that I coveted.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You believe that you can prevent calamity from occurring again by destroying it.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You believe that you can prevent calamity from occurring again by destroying it.

speaker: Logos
content: It's true.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]'True'. Destroy the altar, put a temporary stop to the Cunabula of Suffering, allow the Victorian nitwits to cling to life a bit longer. How boring.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: 'True'. Destroy the altar, put a temporary stop to the Cunabula of Suffering, allow the Victorian nitwits to cling to life a bit longer. How boring.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]Who is the one that's short-sighted and foolish here?
speaker: Duq'arael
content: Who is the one that's short-sighted and foolish here?

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You feel it, don't you? You're closely linked to the altar. Right here, right now, your power is being boosted by it.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You feel it, don't you? You're closely linked to the altar. Right here, right now, your power is being boosted by it.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]It was never one drop of blood or a single person's call that awakened the Cunabula of Suffering.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: It was never one drop of blood or a single person's call that awakened the Cunabula of Suffering.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]Originium is the response to the call of all Sarkaz, living and dead. No exceptions.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: Originium is the response to the call of all Sarkaz, living and dead. No exceptions.

raw: [name="Logos"]...The murmur of the myriad souls is omnipresent.
speaker: Logos
content: ...The murmur of the myriad souls is omnipresent.

raw: [name="Logos"]The lament of the dead will not stop.
speaker: Logos
content: The lament of the dead will not stop.

raw: [name="Logos"]The Sarkaz are bound by the past from the moment of their birth, never to be freed, even unto death.
speaker: Logos
content: The Sarkaz are bound by the past from the moment of their birth, never to be freed, even unto death.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You witnessed the myriad souls the first time you sang an elegy... Laqeramaline proudly described your talent to us.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You witnessed the myriad souls the first time you sang an elegy... Laqeramaline proudly described your talent to us.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]This talent was the seed of dissent.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: This talent was the seed of dissent.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You feel pain, not just for others, but for yourself as well. You may detest the path I walk, but you could not help but feel sorrow for me sake.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You feel pain, not just for others, but for yourself as well. You may detest the path I walk, but you could not help but feel sorrow for me sake.

raw: [name="Logos"]I feel sorrow for how you're trapped by the past.
speaker: Logos
content: I feel sorrow for how you're trapped by the past.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]Such arrogance... I should try to kill you again.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: Such arrogance... I should try to kill you again.

speaker: Duq'arael
content: But instead, I will bless you.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]The slaughterer and the slaughtered... they are all part of the cycle.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: The slaughterer and the slaughtered... they are all part of the cycle.

speaker: Duq'arael
content: I am here because of you.

raw: Logos does not smell any blood.
content: Logos does not smell any blood.

raw: The incantation easily impales the Sanguinarch's body, causing only a few small ripples.
content: The incantation easily impales the Sanguinarch's body, causing only a few small ripples.

raw: [name="Logos"]Your blood is still linked to my elegy.
speaker: Logos
content: Your blood is still linked to my elegy.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]Of course... of course. You stand with me, no matter how much you resist.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: Of course... of course. You stand with me, no matter how much you resist.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]We are all sovereigns of the Royal Court, after all... the oldest bloodlines of the Sarkaz.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: We are all sovereigns of the Royal Court, after all... the oldest bloodlines of the Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]I should be glad that you could conquer me, for it proves that you are stronger, and more worthy of carrying the fate of the Sarkaz, leading them on your path.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: I should be glad that you could conquer me, for it proves that you are stronger, and more worthy of carrying the fate of the Sarkaz, leading them on your path.

raw: The Sanguinarch of Vampires laughs, turning around and disappearing into the cave.
content: The Sanguinarch of Vampires laughs, turning around and disappearing into the cave.

raw: His silhouette fades away amongst the Originium crystals, but his voice continues to echo in Logos's ear.
content: His silhouette fades away amongst the Originium crystals, but his voice continues to echo in Logos's ear.

speaker: Duq'arael
content: Bless you, Aefanyl, my vanquisher.

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]Assimilate my blood. Utilize my power. Let your hatred of me fuel your battles!
speaker: Duq'arael
content: Assimilate my blood. Utilize my power. Let your hatred of me fuel your battles!

raw: [name="Duq'arael"]You will walk in my place and witness in my stead how far the flames of Sarkaz vengeance will burn.
speaker: Duq'arael
content: You will walk in my place and witness in my stead how far the flames of Sarkaz vengeance will burn.

speaker: Logos
content: Refuse.

raw: [name="Logos"]Nachzehrer, Vampire, we all hear the same cry.
speaker: Logos
content: Nachzehrer, Vampire, we all hear the same cry.

raw: [name="Logos"]The fate of the Sarkaz is caught in a cycle, and I am no exception.
speaker: Logos
content: The fate of the Sarkaz is caught in a cycle, and I am no exception.

raw: [name="Logos"]I am part of what I'm fighting.
speaker: Logos
content: I am part of what I'm fighting.

raw: [name="Logos"]The fury of the Sarkaz burns within my veins and my viscera.
speaker: Logos
content: The fury of the Sarkaz burns within my veins and my viscera.

raw: Words turn into fire, descending from the sky to ignite every seed on the earth.
content: Words turn into fire, descending from the sky to ignite every seed on the earth.

raw: Incantations burn at Logos's fingertips, on his lips, in his chest.
content: Incantations burn at Logos's fingertips, on his lips, in his chest.

raw: Originium crystals grow furiously around him, and the crying of the dead becomes even louder, ready to accept him and devour him at any time.
content: Originium crystals grow furiously around him, and the crying of the dead becomes even louder, ready to accept him and devour him at any time.

raw: He no longer rejects the power in his blood. The Vampire has guided the flames of the Sarkaz to him, and he has embraced the fire.
content: He no longer rejects the power in his blood. The Vampire has guided the flames of the Sarkaz to him, and he has embraced the fire.

raw: [name="Logos"]'The abyss lies before us. We can fill it with flesh, and burn the remnants with blood.'
speaker: Logos
content: 'The abyss lies before us. We can fill it with flesh, and burn the remnants with blood.'

raw: [name="Logos"]If the only way to bring new life is to burn away all the decay, then I will be both flame and fuel.
speaker: Logos
content: If the only way to bring new life is to burn away all the decay, then I will be both flame and fuel.

raw: [name="Logos"]This is where my blood belongs, that I have chosen.
speaker: Logos
content: This is where my blood belongs, that I have chosen.

content: Flames consume the entire canyon.

raw: The only things left are the incantations that the young Banshee has written his entire life, from a very young age.
content: The only things left are the incantations that the young Banshee has written his entire life, from a very young age.

raw: They surround Logos loyally, his sword and shield.
content: They surround Logos loyally, his sword and shield.

raw: [name="Logos"]If war is the only way to achieve the dream, and new life can only emerge from death...
speaker: Logos
content: If war is the only way to achieve the dream, and new life can only emerge from death...

speaker: Logos
content: I shall bring death.

speaker: Logos
content: I shall welcome death.

raw: [name="Logos"]I shall ignite my past with blood, not for vengeance—
speaker: Logos
content: I shall ignite my past with blood, not for vengeance—

raw: [name="Logos"]But for the day when this fire will burn away what shackles the Sarkaz, through the decay that covers the land.
speaker: Logos

A bone whistle sounds.

raw: Logos knows that it is merely the echo of the bone whistle in the Valley of the Banshees, the night he set out for Babel.
content: Logos knows that it is merely the echo of the bone whistle in the Valley of the Banshees, the night he set out for Babel.
From death comes new life.
The death knell rings.

raw: For the Royal Court that would rot, past and future, and for himself.
content: For the Royal Court that would rot, past and future, and for himself.
